summary: The pure kernel passed its narrow source review with a trusted complete evidence producer. The one-path map passed its component source review subject to its documented immutable dependency tree, independently owned and isolated server, live seals and post-drain readback. Both HTTP controls, the watcher behavior, browser, application, session readback, finance and recovery remain unrun here. The collector and integration are rejected.

findings.title: No valid map can enter the collector
findings.detail: The map uses exactly 12 hexadecimal characters for its run and signs that literal. The collector requires this same value to equal a run starting with b018_ followed by 12 hexadecimal characters. Both constraints cannot hold. Use one canonical run for the map, verifier, parent and HMAC, with an explicit derivation of the disposable database name. Test the actual cross-module contract.

findings.title: The native redirect proof can reconstruct an invented chain
findings.detail: The producer searches four independent phase/method/path/status matches in expected order. It never establishes one navigation, origin, chronological order, request/redirect lineage, exact hop list, landing identity or matching main frame and loader across the chain. A pure replay of the exact collector loop accepted reversed events with four unrelated IDs, frames and loaders, including a foreign-origin Fetch, and serialized the expected chain. Bind each hop and both document endpoints to the actual click and observed main-frame navigation. Preserve ordinary enabled cancellations as fatal.

findings.title: A successful cross-origin redirect can evade the error ledger and reach an external host
findings.detail: The route callback checks only intercepted requests. Chromium Playwright explicitly continues redirected requests without invoking that callback. Both request listeners accept successful foreign hops and journal paths without origin. The default context also allows service workers, and there is no WebSocket handling. Enforce loopback at the independent transport boundary before navigation, record every observed hop and target, disable or reject unsupported transports and worker interception, and treat each foreign attempt as fatal. Include a redirect-origin and socket control.

findings.title: Late successful evidence conflicts and observer loss can survive the final cut
findings.detail: Each document freezes its hop count, policy and execution evidence at capture. The live enabled landing remains open while later actors run. A second completed webpack request for the same loader or a later duplicate script parse can update observer buffers before the global cut without adding any failure. The cut checks quiet counts and failed terminal IDs only. A crash, unexpected CDP/page close or extra page after the cut also has no fatal listener, and closeContexts can report closed based only on quiet maps and a context close. Reconcile all scoped request/parse/observer records at the cut and through final drain, reject conflicting evidence and unexpected targets/disconnects, and distinguish expected shutdown explicitly. Test delayed successful duplicates and a lost observer with no active requests.

findings.title: The PW and V8 document attribution can borrow identities from another render
findings.detail: PW candidates use a main-frame boolean and mutable phase. ScriptParsed uses only a frame and phase. The collector copies the selected CDP loader and document into the PW record and constructs one shared HMAC. It never proves that both sources and the particular execution context belonged to that loader. The tree check compares only the frame, allowing a same-frame navigation between response and DOM inspection. Reject competing navigations, establish the current loader and a bounded document lifetime, map execution contexts to that lifetime, and correlate raw PW/CDP records without assigning an unobserved loader by assumption.

findings.title: The proposed verifier callback is an unresolved source dependency
findings.detail: This version calls the rejected v2-shaped verifier after landing without an actor/mode attempt binding. The cookie inventory does positively reject duplicate named cookies, non-root paths, foreign domains and partitioning at its observation points. Those snapshots cannot authenticate a different attempt or substitute for the corrected verifier. Re-freeze the compatible collector, verifier and parent contract together and obtain independent review.
